name: chat
about: What the assistant chat may reach on the open project (docs/assistant-panel.md §5.1): edits of the document modules, which run inside the message's one undo step; publishing drafts into the open project without asking (unasked), while a publish to a library asks; files, fabrication output and the 3D model up to an ask, which waits for the person's Allow in the chat; and the window, which it may steer (select, open a workspace) but never edit. The app adds the open project's folder as the only folder a path may name. Settings and the network are out of reach because reach lists neither.
